instruction: Find the travel extras and upgrades page on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: Task variation: Navigate from United Airlines homepage to travel extras and upgrades page. Uses same URL pattern matching evaluator. Similar difficulty to original task (single navigation goal within same website).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_active_tab_info getter to extract the active tab's URL
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly performs regex pattern matching on the URL
Expected pattern 'united.com/en/us/fly/travel/extras' will correctly match the target URL path
Coverage is appropriate - verifying the URL is sufficient for a simple navigation task
Pattern is correctly formatted as a list for the metric function
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor concern: get_active_tab_info reloads the target URL page, which could cause navigation to a different page if there are redirects or cookies (see function warning at chrome.py:806-807). Consider using get_active_url_from_accessTree directly if this becomes an issue.
The evaluator only checks URL presence, not whether the user actively navigated there vs. directly typing the URL, but this is acceptable for this task type
